brief: Clear all encroaching vegetation and obstructions maintaining airflow to the radiator banks and ventilation openings, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity before a forecast heat event according to SOP-011. Because this 50-year-old unit has degraded cooling and cannot be fully attended, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed by MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period pursuant to MG-021.
